capital.evidence_quote: Windhoek is the capital and largest city of the Republic of Namibia

currency.evidence_quote: The Namibia Dollar (NAD) is pegged 1:1 with the South African Rand; ZAR is legal tender

sources.title: Government of the Republic of Namibia

timezone.evidence_quote: Namibia observes Central Africa Time UTC+2 year-round with no seasonal clock changes

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential alternating supply voltage across Namibia is 220V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: National electrical grid alternating frequency is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Outlets in Namibia predominantly utilize South African large three-round-pin Type M and Type D sockets

police.evidence_quote: Dial 10111 for emergency police response across Namibia

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 061 211111 or private EMS for emergency ambulance services in Windhoek

fire.evidence_quote: Call 061 211111 for municipal fire and technical rescue brigades

general.evidence_quote: 112 functions as the cellular emergency dispatch number in Namibia

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist assistance and road safety emergency lines operate in Windhoek and Swakopmund

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Namibya genelinde güvenlik seviyesi yüksektir; çöl yollarında 4x4 araç ve bol su taşınması hayati önemdedir.
advisory_headline.en: Namibia is peaceful and politically stable; carry ample water and spare tires on remote gravel desert roads.
advisory_headline.de: Namibia ist ein friedliches Reiseland; auf Schotterpisten ausreichend Wasser und Ersatzreifen mitführen.
advisory_headline.ru: В Намибии спокойная обстановка; на гравийных дорогах пустыни обязательно имейте запас воды и колес.
advisory_headline.es: Namibia es muy tranquila y segura; lleve suficiente agua y ruedas de repuesto en rutas de ripio.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Namibia measure approximately 28.5 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Namibia reach 44.2 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: MTC Namibia and Telecom Namibia offer 4G tourist eSIMs. Connectivity is strong in Windhoek and Swakopmund, but nonexistent in deep Namib-Naukluft desert dunes; download offline satellite GPS maps before venturing out.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid Aweh packages provide high-speed mobile data across urban towns

us.conditions: US citizens can travel to Namibia visa-free for tourist stays of up to 90 days per calendar year.

source.title: Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security of Namibia

de.conditions: German and EU citizens do not require a visa for tourist visits of up to 90 days in Namibia.

source.title: Ministry of Home Affairs of Namibia

gb.conditions: British passport holders can visit Namibia visa-free for tourist stays of up to 90 days in a calendar year.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут въезжать в Намибию без визы на срок до 90 дней в течение одного календарного года.

source.title: Namibia Investment Promotion and Development Board (NIPDB)

dos.title: Rent a 4x4 with dual spare tires for self-drive
dos.description: Namibia's stunning landscapes are connected by unpaved gravel roads (C & D roads); reduce tire pressure and carry two spares.

dos.title: Use South African Rand (ZAR) interchangeably
dos.description: South African Rand banknotes are legal tender everywhere in Namibia at 1:1; note that Namibian Dollars are not accepted back in South Africa.

dos.title: Climb Dune 45 at sunrise in Sossusvlei
dos.description: Enter Sesriem gate at dawn to see the iconic red dunes of Deadvlei cast dramatic golden shadows.

donts.title: Don't drive faster than 80 km/h on gravel roads
donts.description: Loose gravel causes severe rollover accidents; keep speeds moderate and avoid sudden braking.

donts.title: Don't touch or disturb ancient rock art
donts.description: Twyfelfontein rock petroglyphs (UNESCO) are fragile archaeological treasures; never touch or spray water on engravings.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in restaurants; tipping car guards (N$5-10) who watch vehicles in supermarket parking lots is standard practice.
